findings: Medium: Public support inclusion is numerically inconsistent. Geometry.PointCloud.Kernels.cpp squares finite positive h, so Weight(0, 1e-200, ...) returns 0 and Weight(0, 1e200, ...) returns nullopt although every documented kernel equals 1 at zero distance. The density path also downcasts double h to float for its KD-tree query, allowing rounding-down to omit a neighbor whose double-precision distance is strictly inside support and falsely return EmptyNeighborhood. Use an overflow-safe distance/support ratio, conservatively round the broad-phase radius upward before exact Weight filtering, and add extreme-scale and nextafter-boundary regressions under normal, ASan, and UBSan.
untested_surfaces: Extreme positive support scales and float/double support-boundary rounding.
